notes: Summary: TritonRush runs programmatic RTB; decision hinge: p99 latency and unit cost for high-volume reranking/embedding lookup.
Primary workload: per-impression rerank (50-150 tokens inference) + user embedding lookup for personalization (512-d embeddings cached).
Targets: p99 inference latency <= 25ms (ideal <15ms) for reranking path, steady-state throughput 800-1,200 qps per region, burst to 4k qps.
Cost sensitivity: wants cost estimate per 1M requests; procurement pushing for < $X per 1M where X TBD in POC (highly cost-sensitive).
Model preferences: prefer open Llama-family variants; comfortable with 7B/13B quantized variants. Interested in Redwood's verified model profiles and quantization guidance.

Optimize interest: explicit ask for batching/caching/quantization recommendations — especially continuous batching without hurting p99, prefix/KV caching to avoid recompute, and nv4/nf4 quantization tradeoffs.

Perf benchmarking request: run Redwood-hosted perf benchmark simulating RTB traffic (Poisson bursts, variable seq length) + Triton baseline. Deliverables: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, cost per throughput, CPU/GPU utilization traces.

Architecture asks: VPC peering to our analytics VPC, KMS integration for keys, detailed audit logs for inference calls, ability to pin model versions and auto-fallback to smaller quantized variant during capacity shortage.
Quote from CTO: 'We need predictable tail latency — if p99 slips, the bid loses; cost matters but not at expense of reliability.'
POC scope draft: 2 regions (us-east-1, us-west-2), dedicated pool in one region + hosted fallback, run bench for 72h steady-state + 24h burst window, measure cold-start impact and cache hit ratios.

Technical concerns raised: how batching affects p99 for 50-150 token requests, how KV cache TTLs interact with freshness for personalization, quantization artifacts on reranking quality (A/B test needed).
Requested artifacts: Redwood perf script, example batching config, quantization profile suggestions (4-bit NF4), cost worksheet mapped to TritonRush QPS curve.
Internal next: procurement to confirm POC budget by 2026-03-17; SE (Riley) to schedule benchmark kickoff once VPC peering approved.
